excludes: Every protected effect remains with the owner: production deployment, production or destructive database mutation, real email, SMS or messaging send, payment or live charge, raw credential access or rotation, secrets disclosure, OpenAI API credential provisioning, API billing activation, credit purchase or API spend, Secure MCP Tunnel credential activation, Windows service installation or identity change, ACL, ProgramData or registry trust mutation, destructive machine operation, and force push.
Material commercial or scope change remains with the owner.

This delegation carries closure decisions and gatekeeper review decisions only. It is not authority to act, and it is not plan-approval authority — the owner approved this programme's plan personally and no plan-approval delegation exists for it. A gatekeeper review decision is a recommendation on the questions ProjectOS's own gatekeeper turn asks it; it is not a closure decision, and the delegation's closure authority is unchanged by carrying this second scope.

The technical-continuation scope covers ordinary governed commit, ordinary normal push and fast-forward-only integration ONLY. It carries no force push, no force-with-lease, no arbitrary refspec, no tag or release, no branch deletion, no rebase, no automatic conflict resolution, no merge that is not a fast forward, no amend, no reset, and no arbitrary command, shell or script execution of any kind. Every protected effect listed above remains with the owner and is unaffected by it.
notes: Scoped to projectId 'projectos' AND to programme 'projectos-autonomous-self-hosting'. It cannot be read as authority in any other project or any other programme, and it grants the implementer nothing: Claude may never exercise closure authority, which the runtime enforces independently of this record. The 'technical-continuation' scope is NOT by itself permission to act: it records that this CLASS of technical authority may be delegated to ChatGPT for this project and programme. Which action is performed still requires a live gatekeeper decision that passed checkGatekeeperDecision and names that action in its allowedActions, the exact reviewed candidate bytes must still match, and ProjectOS will only perform an action from its own closed dispatcher. It carries no closure authority - closure remains governed by the closure scopes above and the existing delegated phase-advance path. As at the date of this amendment the active approved plan still owner-gates commit, push and phase-closure, and the constitutional ALWAYS_OWNER_ONLY floor holds all three regardless of what any plan declares, so this scope grants nothing that can execute today: it is the replacement mechanism, recorded before the owner considers any plan relaxation, and never a substitute for one.
